## Modules

- [Condukt.Agent](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Agent.md): Macro for defining Condukt agents with explicit agent options.
- [Condukt.AgentRuntime](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.AgentRuntime.md): Behaviour for runtimes that own an agent's inner execution loop.
- [Condukt.AgentRuntimes.Claude](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.AgentRuntimes.Claude.md): Runtime adapter for Claude Code non-interactive SDK mode.
- [Condukt.AgentRuntimes.Codex](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.AgentRuntimes.Codex.md): Runtime adapter for the Codex CLI non-interactive SDK mode.
- [Condukt.AgentRuntimes.Native](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.AgentRuntimes.Native.md): Marker module for the built-in Condukt agent loop.
- [Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Hosts](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Hosts.md): Host glob matching shared by the `AllowHosts` and `DenyHosts` rules.
- [Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.K8s](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.K8s.md): Kubernetes-specific glue for the `Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy`
egress layer.
- [Condukt.SessionID](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.SessionID.md): Generates UUIDv7 identifiers for `Condukt.Session` instances.

- Core
  - [Condukt](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.md): A framework for building AI agents in Elixir.
  - [Condukt.Message](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Message.md): Represents a message in the conversation history.
  - [Condukt.Operation](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Operation.md): Typed, named entrypoints on an agent module.
  - [Condukt.Plug](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Plug.md): Exposes Condukt agents and typed operations as HTTP routes.
  - [Condukt.Session](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Session.md): GenServer that manages an agent session.
  - [Condukt.Telemetry](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Telemetry.md): Telemetry integration for Condukt.

- Project Context
  - [Condukt.Context](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Context.md): Loads project instructions and local skills from the active sandbox.
  - [Condukt.Context.Skill](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Context.Skill.md): Metadata for a project skill discovered from `.agents/skills`.

- Engine
  - [Condukt.Engine.CLI](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Engine.CLI.md): Command-line entrypoint for the standalone Condukt engine.

- Tools
  - [Condukt.Tool](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tool.md): Behaviour for defining tools that agents can use.
  - [Condukt.Tool.Inline](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tool.Inline.md): Struct returned by `Condukt.tool/1`.
  - [Condukt.Tools](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tools.md): Built-in tools for Condukt.
  - [Condukt.Tools.Bash](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tools.Bash.md): Tool for executing bash commands.
  - [Condukt.Tools.Command](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tools.Command.md): Tool for executing one trusted command without shell parsing.
  - [Condukt.Tools.Edit](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tools.Edit.md): Tool for making surgical edits to files.
  - [Condukt.Tools.Glob](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tools.Glob.md): Tool for finding files by glob pattern.
  - [Condukt.Tools.Grep](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tools.Grep.md): Tool for searching file contents by regular expression.
  - [Condukt.Tools.Read](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tools.Read.md): Tool for reading file contents.
  - [Condukt.Tools.Subagent](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tools.Subagent.md): Tool for delegating a task to a registered sub-agent role.
  - [Condukt.Tools.Write](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Tools.Write.md): Tool for writing content to files.

- Workflows
  - [Condukt.Workflows](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Workflows.md): Public facade for Condukt workflows.
  - [Condukt.Workflows.Compiler](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Workflows.Compiler.md): Normalizes `.exs` workflow files to workflow documents.
  - [Condukt.Workflows.Document](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Workflows.Document.md): Loaded representation of a workflow document.
  - [Condukt.Workflows.Executor](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Workflows.Executor.md): Executes a validated workflow document.
  - [Condukt.Workflows.Expr](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Workflows.Expr.md): Expression sub-language for Condukt workflows.
  - [Condukt.Workflows.HCLCompiler](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Workflows.HCLCompiler.md): Normalizes HCL workflow files to canonical workflow documents.
  - [Condukt.Workflows.ToolRegistry](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Workflows.ToolRegistry.md): Resolves the `id` field of a `tool` workflow step to a tool module
(or inline tool spec) suitable for `Condukt.Tool.execute/3`.

- MCP
  - [Condukt.MCP](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.MCP.md): Client-side support for the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io).
  - [Condukt.MCP.Client](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.MCP.Client.md): GenServer that owns the protocol state for a single MCP server
connection.
  - [Condukt.MCP.Registry](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.MCP.Registry.md): Lifecycle helper for connecting to a list of MCP servers as part of
starting a session or executing a workflow.
  - [Condukt.MCP.Server](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.MCP.Server.md): Declarative configuration for a connected MCP server.

- Sandbox
  - [Condukt.Sandbox](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.md): Filesystem and process-execution capabilities exposed to tools.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.Kubernetes](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.Kubernetes.md): Sandbox that runs each session inside a dedicated Kubernetes Pod.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.Local](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.Local.md): Sandbox that operates against the host filesystem and host shell.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.md): Per-session network policy for sandbox egress.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.AgentDecider](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.AgentDecider.md): `Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Decider` implementation that delegates to a
`Condukt`-defined agent module.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.CA](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.CA.md): Per-session ephemeral Certificate Authority used by the egress sidecar
for TLS interception.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Context](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Context.md): Snapshot of session state handed to a `Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy`
`:decide` callback per outbound request.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Decider](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Decider.md): Behaviour and runtime for the `:decide` rule on a
`Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy`.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Event](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Event.md): An event the egress runtime emits as telemetry per request lifecycle.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Request](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.NetworkPolicy.Request.md): A single outbound network request observed by the sandbox egress layer.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.Virtual](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.Virtual.md): Sandbox that runs against an in-memory virtual filesystem and a
Rust-implemented bash interpreter via the bashkit NIF.
  - [Condukt.Sandbox.Virtual.Tools.Mount](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Sandbox.Virtual.Tools.Mount.md): Sandbox-specific tool for `Condukt.Sandbox.Virtual` that lets the agent
mount a host directory into the virtual filesystem at runtime.

- Session Stores
  - [Condukt.SessionStore](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.SessionStore.md): Behaviour for persisting and restoring Condukt sessions.
  - [Condukt.SessionStore.Disk](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.SessionStore.Disk.md): Disk-backed session store using Erlang term serialization.
  - [Condukt.SessionStore.Memory](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.SessionStore.Memory.md): ETS-backed session store for restoring sessions within the current VM.

  - [Condukt.SessionStore.Snapshot](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.SessionStore.Snapshot.md): Serializable session snapshot persisted by session stores.

- Compaction
  - [Condukt.Compactor](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Compactor.md): Behaviour for compacting a session's conversation history.
  - [Condukt.Compactor.Sliding](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Compactor.Sliding.md): Keeps the last N messages of the conversation.
  - [Condukt.Compactor.ToolResultPrune](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Compactor.ToolResultPrune.md): Replaces the content of old tool result messages with a small placeholder,
preserving the message structure (and the assistant's tool call reasoning)
so the model still sees that the tool was invoked.

- Redaction
  - [Condukt.Redactor](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Redactor.md): Behaviour for redacting sensitive data before it is sent to an LLM provider.
  - [Condukt.Redactors.Regex](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Redactors.Regex.md): Default regex-based redactor for common high-precision secret patterns.
  - [Condukt.Redactors.Secrets](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Redactors.Secrets.md): Exact-match redactor for resolved session secrets.

- Secrets
  - [Condukt.SecretProvider](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.SecretProvider.md): Behaviour for loading session secrets from trusted providers.
  - [Condukt.Secrets](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Secrets.md): Session-scoped secrets for agent tool execution.
  - [Condukt.Secrets.Providers.Env](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Secrets.Providers.Env.md): Loads a session secret from the host process environment.
  - [Condukt.Secrets.Providers.OnePassword](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Secrets.Providers.OnePassword.md): Loads a session secret from 1Password CLI secret references.
  - [Condukt.Secrets.Providers.Static](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Secrets.Providers.Static.md): Loads a plaintext value from trusted application configuration.

- Providers
  - [Condukt.Providers.Ollama](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Condukt.Providers.Ollama.md): Ollama provider – self-hosted OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix condukt.check](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Condukt.Check.md): Validates a Condukt workflow file without executing it.
- [mix condukt.run](https://condukt.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Condukt.Run.md): Runs a Condukt workflow file.
